strategy_guide_sections.why_it_matters_for_offer: Shows exact live rewards before any walkthrough.
Protects the reader if the offer needs support.
Turns each live row into a guided path.
Names the resources, proof states, and bottlenecks that decide whether the live route is still worth continuing.

task_strategy.task_goal_plain_english: Complete the live task exactly as written: Install.
task_strategy.mechanic_deep_dive: install_open_tracking means the guide must translate the offer wording into a narrow action path, keep proof at every checkpoint, and avoid unrelated game activity that does not move the task.
prerequisites: Start from the EarnGrind tracked route.
Use the eligible device and country shown in the offer.
Do not switch accounts, devices, or VPN state mid-route.
step_by_step_route: Screenshot the Box Away offer row before starting.
Open the tracked route for GemLoot via BitLabs.
Complete only the actions needed for: Install.
Save the completion screen and return to the offerwall to confirm pending or credited status.
resource_requirements: no spend required unless the live task explicitly says purchase
task_conflicts: Spending before confirming tracking can reduce ROI.
Chasing unrelated side content can miss the listed task route.
common_mistakes: assuming a task credited before checking the offerwall
progress_checkpoints: offerwall pending or credited state saved
task_strategy.when_to_stop_or_skip: Stop or reassess if tracking does not show after the first low-risk checkpoint, if the task requires spending more than the listed reward, or if the live route changes.

priority_order: late or paid tasks only after reassessment
gates_and_unlocks: task-specific unlocks named in the offer row
resource_plan: preserve premium currency and boosts until the task route needs them
avoid spending unless purchase economics are favorable
accelerators: official events or bonuses only when visible in game
what_to_ignore: paid shortcuts that do not match a listed task
